en: I stirred the sugar in the coffee.
I didn't move the table from its place.
You stirred the food well with the spoon.

ar: علاش ما حركتيش الطوموبيل من قدام الدار
en: Why didn't you move the car from in front of the house?
You (f.) moved the box to the room.
You (f.) didn't stir the tea well.
He stirred the juice a bit.

ar: هو ما حركش الراس ديالو كاع
en: He didn't move his head at all.
She stirred the tagine with the spoon.

ar: هي ما حركاتش الكرسي من هنا
en: She didn't move the chair from here.
We tossed the salad with oil.
We didn't move the bed from its place.
You (pl.) stirred the milk well.
You (pl.) didn't move the keys from the table.
They moved the wardrobe to the corner.

ar: هما ما حركوش البسكليطة من الباب
en: They didn't move the bicycle from the door.
Now I am stirring the coffee with the spoon.

lat: ana ma kan7erreksh yedi b z-zerba
en: I don't move my hand quickly.
You always stir the soup well.

lat: nta ma kat7erreksh l-ktub mn l-biru
ar: نتا ما كتحركش الكتب من البيرو
en: You don't move the books from the desk.
You (f.) stir the dough by hand.

lat: nti ma kat7errkish l-korsi dyalek bezzaf
ar: نتي ما كتحركيش الكرسي ديالك بزاف
en: You (f.) don't move your chair a lot.
He stirs the tea in the teapot.

lat: huwa ma kay7erreksh rejlu mn l-wje3
ar: هو ما كيحركش رجلو من الوجع
en: He doesn't move his leg because of the pain.
She stirs the soup in the kitchen.

lat: hiya ma kat7erreksh l-werqa mn blastha
ar: هي ما كتحركش الورقة من بلاصتها
en: She doesn't move the paper from its place.
We stir the food in the frying pan.

ar: حنا ما كنحركوش الماكينة ديال الغسيل
en: We don't move the washing machine.
You (pl.) move the car every morning.

lat: ntuma ma kat7errkush l-kora f l-l3eb
en: You (pl.) don't move the ball in the game.
They stir the couscous with clarified butter.
They don't move the big boxes.
I am going to stir the sugar in the glass.

lat: ma ghadish n7errek t-tebsil mn blastu
ar: ما غاديش نحرك الطبسيل من بلاصتو
en: I'm not going to move the plate from its place.

lat: nta ghadi t7errek l-merqa b l-me3leqa
en: You are going to stir the broth with the spoon.

lat: nta ma ghadish t7errek l-mario l-kbir
ar: نتا ما غاديش تحرك الماريو الكبير
en: You are not going to move the big wardrobe.

lat: nti ghadi t7errki l-bid b l-furshita
en: You (f.) are going to stir the eggs with the fork.

lat: nti ma ghadish t7errki l-korsi l-yum
ar: نتي ما غاديش تحركي الكرسي اليوم
en: You (f.) are not going to move the chair today.

lat: huwa ghadi y7errek s-sbagha b l-3sa
en: He is going to stir the paint with the stick.

lat: huwa ma ghadish y7errek l-biru dyalu
ar: هو ما غاديش يحرك البيرو ديالو
en: He is not going to move his desk.

lat: hiya ghadi t7errek l-7rira f l-berma
en: She is going to stir the harira in the pot.

lat: hiya ma ghadish t7errek l-valiza l-yum
ar: هي ما غاديش تحرك الفاليزة اليوم
en: She is not going to move the suitcase today.
We are going to stir the vegetables in the tagine.

lat: 7na ma ghadish n7errku t-tilfaza mn hna
ar: حنا ما غاديش نحركو التلفازة من هنا
en: We are not going to move the TV from here.

lat: ntuma ghadi t7errku l-kura b rejlikum
en: You (pl.) are going to move the ball with your feet.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish t7errku t-tbali l-yum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تحركو الطبالي اليوم
en: You (pl.) are not going to move the tables today.

lat: huma ghadi y7errku l-kamyon f s-sba7
en: They are going to move the truck in the morning.

lat: huma ma ghadish y7errku l-7jar l-kbir
ar: هما ما غاديش يحركو الحجر الكبير
en: They are not going to move the big stone.
